FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Enclave Ranks
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Drill with any colonist. Both stop, stand apart, and draw their weapons for the session. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Collaborate on research with another science-track colonist. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Inspect a lower-ranked officer's weapon and power armor condition against Enclave regulation. Compliant gear earns a commendation, non-compliant gear earns a reprimand.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Sentence a lower-ranked officer to a stretch of hard labor for a regulation breach, souring their mood. Once per day per officer.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Rally every combat-ranked member of {0} on this map with a burst of speed and combat effectiveness. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to assemble behind you in ranks, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They'll hold formation until stood down.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Stand {0} down from formation, letting them return to duty.
